name: Aru Kanrinin no Koi
source:
Jun Minase is suddenly in charge of Shirakaba House, a dormitory full of foreign exchange students after the former manager is unable to resume his duties.

How will all these foreign exchange students manage with their different cultures?

Will there ever be peaceful days for Jun?

[Edited from [url=https://aheadofthenight.wordpress.com/dormitory-love-springsummer-translation-project/]aheadofthenight on Wordpress[/url]]
translation:
前任管理員無法復職後，水瀨淳臨時接手白樺宿舍，裡頭住的全是外國留學生。

來自不同文化的留學生們該如何相處？

淳還能擁有平靜的日子嗎？

[改編自[url=https://aheadofthenight.wordpress.com/dormitory-love-springsummer-translation-project/]aheadofthenight的WordPress[/url]]
